headline: The CURD Act would have set a federal legal definition for natural cheese, but the House voted it down in December 2018.
what_it_does: The bill would have amended the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to add a definition for natural cheese. The official summary is brief and does not describe the exact wording of that definition or any penalties. Because the bill was not adopted, none of these changes apply.

who_it_affects.group: Cheese makers and food companies that sell natural cheese
who_it_affects.how: They would have had a single federal definition of natural cheese to follow if the bill had become law.
Labels on natural cheese would have been tied to the federal definition, though the summary does not say how that would have changed what appears on packages.
